text:
sam.dev: starting a coordinated publish for the SDK (py+ts) to cut 2.0.0-rc2 tonight. quiet window 01:00-02:00 UTC. plan: publish staged artifacts, run smoke (auth + small embedding batch), then promote if green. :hourglass:

ivy.releases: please ensure the release script creates both a 'staging' and an explicit 'rollback' dist-tag before any promotion. we'll need the rollback tag ready for emergency fastflip.

ops-bot: reminder: change window 01:00-02:00 UTC registered for release-team. Notifications sent to #oncall.

deploy-bot: Publish started by sam.dev at 1765010025
deploy-bot: npm package publish -> success (tag: staging)
deploy-bot: pypi upload -> success
deploy-bot: Canary: traffic 7% -> running checks

kevin.docs: i can prep release notes and a deprecation snippet for the old sync adapter. do you want the deprecation note to point to the migration guide or inline steps?

sam.dev: link to migration guide is fine. i'll add the short troubleshooting section for 429/401 cases.

ivy.releases: running automated smoke: auth loop + embedding batch of size 32. script: 
```
for i in 1..8; do \
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"inputs": [1,2,3]}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/emb | jq -r '.status' \
  || break; \
done
```

ivy.releases: getting intermittent 429s at iteration 5. excerpt: `rate_limiter: worker=emb-03 batch=32 exceeded=429`. holding promo, rolling npm dist-tag back to previous stable.

sam.dev: executing rollback commands now:
```
# roll npm back to previous stable
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.4 latest
# tag current broken rc as rollback for visibility
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0-rc2 rollback
```

deploy-bot: Dist-tag update requested at 1765010150
deploy-bot: Dist-tag `latest` now -> 1.9.4 at 1765010160

ops-bot: Telemetry alert cleared after rollback. 429 spike subsided. :white_check_mark:

ivy.releases: notes for postmortem: root cause likely changed default batching behavior in the new client; didn't surface in unit tests because we mock rate limits. action items: (1) add CI smoke that runs small embedding batches against staging infra, (2) add a release checklist step to create `rollback` and `staging` tags before promote, (3) add a canary metric that triggers at cluster-wide 429 > 1% during rollout. assigning: ivy.releases (CI smoke), sam.dev (release script tag change), ops-bot (canary metric).

kevin.docs: drafted CHANGELOG + deprecation blurb, PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/612. includes migration link to docs/migration/sync-client.md and a troubleshooting snippet for 401/429.

sam.dev: thanks. we'll re-open a new thread when the batching fix is in and the CI smoke passes. logging this as a soft cancel for tonight's window. :thumbsup:
